title: Thermoplastic compositions containing nanoscale-sized particle additives for laser direct structuring and methods for the manufacture and use thereof
abstract: The present invention relates generally to thermoplastic compositions and, more particularly, to compositions comprising a polymer matrix and comprising a filler composition. To this end, according to aspects of the present invention, a composition is disclosed generally comprising a polymer matrix and at least one filler composition. The polymer matrix generally comprises one or more polycarbonates or polyamides. The filler composition generally comprises one or more laser direct structuring additives having an average particle size of less than 1 μm and may additionally optionally include flame retardants, stabilizers and processing aids.
